test_title: PYST 25: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All patties are cake.

All cakes are samosa.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some samosas are cake.

(II): All patties are samosa.
solution:
Statements:

All patties are cake.

All cakes are samosa.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b58773bf12d45593df91e7d03369e7f31693080219b831de040b15cca5ac34b.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some samosas are cake. - Follow (Because, All cakes are samosa, which means Some samosas are cake.)

(II): All patties are samosa. Follow (Because, All patties are cake and All cakes are samosa, which means all patties being cakes are samosas too.)

Thus, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
